import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 15;
    static final int M = 100005;
    static final int INF = (int)1e9;
    static final int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static final int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static char[][] c = new char[N][N];
    static char[][] S = new char[N][N];
    static int[][] id = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] dis = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] vis = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] Dis = new int[N][N];
    static int[] que = new int[M];
    static int[] fox = new int[N*N*2+5];
    static int[] dist = new int[N*N*2+5];
    static Edge[] s = new Edge[M];
    static int k1 = 1;
    static int st, ed, tot, n, t;
    static int sx, sy;

    static class Edge {
        int ed, before, flow;
        Edge(int ed, int flow, int before) {
            this.ed = ed;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.before = before;
        }
    }

    static boolean bfs() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
        int l = 1, r = 1;
        dist[st] = 0;
        que[1] = st;
        while (l <= r) {
            int p = que[l];
            for (int i = fox[p]; i != 0; i = s[i].before) {
                if (s[i].flow > 0 && dist[s[i].ed] == -1) {
                    que[++r] = s[i].ed;
                    dist[s[i].ed] = dist[p] + 1;
                }
            }
            l++;
        }
        return dist[ed] != -1;
    }

    static void add(int p1, int p2, int p3) {
        s[++k1] = new Edge(p2, p3, fox[p1]);
        fox[p1] = k1;
        s[++k1] = new Edge(p1, 0, fox[p2]);
        fox[p2] = k1;
    }

    static int dfs(int num, int flow) {
        if (num == ed) return flow;
        int nowans = 0;
        for (int i = fox[num]; i != 0 && flow > 0; i = s[i].before) {
            if (s[i].flow > 0 && dist[s[i].ed] == dist[num] + 1) {
                int a = dfs(s[i].ed, Math.min(s[i].flow, flow));
                if (a > 0) {
                    s[i].flow -= a;
                    s[i^1].flow += a;
                    flow -= a;
                    nowans += a;
                }
            }
        }
        if (nowans == 0) dist[num] = INF;
        return nowans;
    }

    static int maxflow() {
        int ans = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            int j = dfs(st, INF);
            while (j > 0) {
                ans += j;
                j = dfs(st, INF);
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static boolean check(int x, int y) {
        if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= n || y >= n || vis[x][y] == 1 || c[x][y] < '0' || c[x][y] > '9')
            return false;
        return true;
    }

    static void Bfs() {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(dis[i], 60);
        dis[sx][sy] = 0;
        int l = 1, r = 0;
        Node[] Q = new Node[100005];
        Q[++r] = new Node(sx, sy);
        vis[sx][sy] = 1;
        while (l <= r) {
            int ax = Q[l].x, ay = Q[l].y;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = ax + dx[i], ny = ay + dy[i];
                if (check(nx, ny)) {
                    dis[nx][ny] = dis[ax][ay] + 1;
                    vis[nx][ny] = 1;
                    Q[++r] = new Node(nx, ny);
                }
            }
            l++;
        }
    }

    static void Find(int tx, int ty, int idx) {
        int l = 1, r = 0;
        Node[] Q = new Node[100005];
        Q[++r] = new Node(tx, ty);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(vis[i], 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(Dis[i], 60);
        vis[tx][ty] = 1;
        Dis[tx][ty] = 0;
        while (l <= r) {
            int ax = Q[l].x, ay = Q[l].y;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = ax + dx[i], ny = ay + dy[i];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n && vis[nx][ny] == 0 && c[nx][ny] >= '0' && c[nx][ny] <= '9') {
                    Dis[nx][ny] = Dis[ax][ay] + 1;
                    vis[nx][ny] = 1;
                    if (Dis[nx][ny] < dis[nx][ny]) {
                        Q[++r] = new Node(nx, ny);
                    }
                }
            }
            l++;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Dis[i][j] <= t && S[i][j] > '0' && S[i][j] <= '9' && Dis[i][j] <= dis[i][j]) {
                    add(idx, id[i][j] + tot, INF);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static class Node {
        int x, y;
        Node(int x, int y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                c[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                S[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        // find start 'Z'
        sx = -1; sy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (c[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sx = i;
                    sy = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (sx != -1) break;
        }
        // assign ids
        tot = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                id[i][j] = ++tot;
            }
        }
        st = 2 * tot + 1;
        ed = st + 1;
        // initialize edges
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) s[i] = new Edge(0, 0, 0);
        Bfs();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (c[i][j] > '0' && c[i][j] <= '9') {
                    add(st, id[i][j], c[i][j] - '0');
                    Find(i, j, id[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (S[i][j] > '0' && S[i][j] <= '9') {
                    add(id[i][j] + tot, ed, S[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(maxflow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
